items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And then Donny, he was going to be a flautist

ctx.x: Seven times, seven grandchildren, and none of them got into music either. Roddy, he's in Milwaukee.

He's a television announcer in Milwaukee, and he -- he started to playing guitar and stuff. And then Donny, he was going to be a flautist, and he got into something else. They all got into something else.

And, oh, my other granddaughter, she's a policewoman in California, and she was going to -- she started playing flute and clarinet, and she had a beautiful voice, good singer, and she never followed -- she got into police work and -- they're all on their other little things, you know.
